Rajat Nayar, a renowned astrologer, predicts the future on the basis of the position of the stars and planets. His insights blend ancient wisdom with modern astronomy, attracting diverse clients.
Priests and devout Hindus offer prayers to Goddess Vaishno Devi and perform rituals along with singing devotional songs.
A renowned astrologer provides a comprehensive and detailed insight, elucidating on the various aspects of horoscope and its significance.
The hosts explore various exotic destinations around the globe to experience the life and vibrant culture and traditions of these places.
